---
title: "About me"
description: |
 Since I was a young, I’ve always been the person to spend extra time on the trailhead staring at the structure of a trees leaf, or watching a bee pollinate a flower, as my family continued to walk, leaving me in the distance. This passion for nature is what has guided me down the path of biological studies. As I studied at Utah Valley University, I began to narrow my passion to understanding ecological systems and how evolutionary processes have led to the formation of such ecosystems. I have graduated with a Bachelor’s in Biology with a hope to next obtain a PhD degree. I have recently aquired GIS certification and will next achieve MLT certification. I hope, throughout my life, to continue studying the various processes that make our world so beautiful and worth spending a few extra minutes on the trailhead.
---
